summary: Fix confirmed. At the fix parent e0cfb2e93c6d, reloading an unquantized Linear from the in-memory override (get_tensors, stc.set_new_tensors, load) kept the exported (out, in) orientation: the rectangular q_proj loaded as [512, 256] instead of [256, 512] and forward raised RuntimeError 'mat1 and mat2 shapes cannot be multiplied' at exllamav3/modules/quant/fp16.py:73; the square o_proj loaded transposed and its forward differed from the file-backed load by up to 1.94. At the fix 538dcae36589 both reloads equal the file-backed weight exactly and forward matches (diff 0.0). The listed affected commit 647bb7d549b8 was not run: its extension cannot be built (stloader.cpp and stloader.cu both map to stloader.o, so ninja refuses; build-647bb7d549b8.log). The override branch at 647bb7d549b8 is textually identical to the fix parent's.
what_ran: repro.py writes a tiny random LlamaForCausalLM checkpoint, builds exllamav3.modules.Linear over a rectangular (256 -> 512) and a square (256 -> 256) weight, loads each from file, then repeats the reload sequence convert_model.main uses after a module (collect get_tensors, config.stc.set_new_tensors, load(device, source=...), set_new_tensors(None)) and compares weight and forward with the file-backed load. Physical GPU 1.
limits: The reload is driven directly with conversion's calls; no built-in model at these commits was found whose conversion leaves a linear unquantized inside a quantized module, so a full convert.py run does not reach it. 647bb7d549b8 not executed (extension build failure). float2half and padding behaviour of the override branch were not tested (not claimed fixed). Synthetic weights; one GPU (RTX 3090).

model.repo_id: synthetic tiny LlamaForCausalLM generated by repro.py
